ROUTER_COST_CITATION: Router latency defaults (rule≈1 ms, embedding≈5 ms, classifier≈75 ms, LLM≈430 ms) are order-of-magnitude figures from published hybrid-routing practitioner measurements and open router benchmarks (e.g. RouteLLM-style classifier/embedding routers vs generative LLM routers). Exact host calibration is Phase 5; these values are labeled as practitioner-sourced priors, not this corpus's measurements.

orch_floor_ms.source: midpoint of CAP-01 langgraph floor band [3.9, 7.0] ms

orch_floor_ms_lo.source: CAP-01 protocol_cap01_v2.json floor_anchor.promoted_reference_bands_ms.langgraph[0]; TurnTrace/CAP-01 measured orchestration floor

orch_floor_ms_hi.source: CAP-01 protocol_cap01_v2.json floor_anchor.promoted_reference_bands_ms.langgraph[1]; TurnTrace/CAP-01 measured orchestration floor

rule.source: practitioner router latency survey (rule-based): ~1 ms; see params.ROUTER_COST_CITATION

embedding.source: practitioner router latency survey (embedding similarity): ~5 ms; see params.ROUTER_COST_CITATION

classifier.source: practitioner router latency survey (small classifier): ~75 ms; see params.ROUTER_COST_CITATION

llm.source: practitioner router latency survey (LLM-as-router): ~430 ms; see params.ROUTER_COST_CITATION

decision_power_w.source: conservative host package draw during light CPU orchestration (order-of-magnitude; Phase 5 RAPL calibration replaces)

local_model_latency_ms_lo.source: user-stated TurnTrace crossover band lower edge (5.4–8.4 ms) where orchestration floor meets short local model calls

local_model_latency_ms_hi.source: user-stated TurnTrace crossover band upper edge (5.4–8.4 ms)

cloud_prefill_ms_per_token.source: OA-01 nonstreaming corpus lacks prefill isolate; 0.05 ms/token is a conservative cloud prefill prior consistent with TurnTrace C1 openai-processing-ms / token ratios on short contexts (order 0.03–0.1 ms/tok)

local_prefill_ms_per_token.source: local GPU/NPU prefill prior ~0.4 ms/token for mid-size local models under common llama.cpp/vLLM deployments; Phase 5 replaces with box-calibrated f(n)

max_speedup.source: TLP-01 Tier-C rate-limit floor speedup on MT-RS-01 (apu_characterization/out/tlp01/t2/t2_ladder_report.md: 1.19x)

assumed_concurrency.source: illustrative naive 'unlimited cloud parallelism' assumption used only when F3 is OFF; not a measurement

capacity_factor.source: UNMEASURED Phase-2 stub: no degradation; Phase 5 replaces with measured discharge/recharge curves

local_decode_ms_per_token.source: local decode prior ~8 ms/token (small/mid local model); Phase 5 box calibration replaces

local_usd_per_kwh.source: US average retail electricity order-of-magnitude (EIA-style); used only for local USD proxy

local_power_w.source: illustrative GPU/NPU package draw during generation; Phase 5 RAPL/NVML replaces

cloud_prefill_ms_per_token.source: same prior as F2Params.cloud_prefill_ms_per_token (TurnTrace C1 processing-ms/token order)

cloud_decode_ms_per_token.source: practitioner cloud decode prior ~25 ms/output-token when streaming isolate absent (OA-01 nonstreaming); used only as fallback when logged_latency_ms is missing
